exposure: fundal pressure during the second stage of labor (Kristeller)
outcome: Women's experiences with information, accompaniment, and free position during childbirth
cohort: 388 women who gave birth in health centers in Quito, Ecuador between July 2016 and July 2017
finding: Obstetric violence was observed in all three components studied: information, accompaniment, and free position, with many women not informed about procedures, not allowed accompaniment, and not given the opportunity to choose their birthing position.
